warrant: Pointwise split-generator storage is not graded because generator order and sentinels are bookkeeping; the policy compares split count, summed physical split positions and total waveform area separately for every deterministic input case. Missing a valley changes count or position by at least one, and per-case comparison prevents opposite errors in different cases from cancelling in a mean.
